title: fix(scenarios): the seed leaves out the card values of the build's roll-ups, so a payment capped at its invoice's open balance loads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuWUUzJ4EEzDD7fb56jyq1TP)_

Fixes #35654

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：评测跑器往应用里灌示例数据时，不再写入「自动汇总」类字段的值（比如发票的已付金额，它本该由付款记录加出来），改由平台按付款自己算。
- 为什么：订单回款这张评测卡把每张发票的已付金额终态直接写进去。一个做得很对的应用（已付金额 = 付款合计，并且付款不得超过未付余额）在灌数据时就会把已付清发票的 66 笔付款当成超付拒掉，评测因此冤枉正确的应用。
- 评测卡本身和上一个 PR 入库的验证构建都没改；只有把这类字段做成自动汇总的应用才受影响，做成普通数字字段的照旧收到卡上的值。发票号、订单号这类自动编号照样写入，因为问题里会引用它们。
- 出错会怎样：只影响评测跑器灌数据这一步，最坏是某张卡的汇总字段起始值不对，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/seed.ts` gains `rollupFields(artifact)`: the fields a built artifact declares `type: 'summary'`, per object, read through the scorer's artifact reader (the same shape as `derivedFields`).

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts`:

- `seedRowBody` takes the object's roll-ups and leaves their card values out of the row, returning them as `leftOut` (`object.field`).
- `seedApp` takes `rollups` (per object) after `required`, and records the left-out columns in the run record's `seed.leftOut` (new optional field on `RunHalf['seed']`, absent when nothing was left out, so a card with no roll-up keeps its record's bytes).
- Both seed calls in the run half (first seed and the fresh-copy reseed) pass `rollupFields(built)`; `restoreSeededRows` re-inserts a seeded row with the same body.

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/screenshots.ts`: the gallery screenshot boot passes the artifact's roll-ups too, so it seeds the same rows the run does.

Why only roll-ups, not every computed type (`derivedFields`: formula, summary, autonumber):

- A roll-up is the case the card's end state breaks. The seed path is a system write, which stores a roll-up value it is sent as written (measured on #34986, report 7022810829), so a child rule that reads the parent's open balance sees the end state before the child that makes it.
- A left-out `count` / `sum` roll-up starts at 0 on insert (`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts`, #5749 / #34672) and each admitted child adds to it, also inside one batch (`summary-batch-accumulation.ts`), so the parent ends at the card's value.
- An autonumber must stay: order_to_cash's committed build declares `name` an autonumber (`INV-{YYYY}-{0000}`), and the card's questions cite `INV-1058`. A first cut that left out every `derivedFields` column also dropped `name` on invoices, payments and orders; the test caught it.
- A stored field with an `expression` (the committed build's `balance`, `status`, `amount`) is recomputed by the engine from the row anyway, so it needs nothing here.

The card is unchanged: every one of its 95 invoices states `amount_paid` equal to the sum of its payments (asserted in the new test), and every sales order's `total_amount` equals the sum of its lines. So its `cardSha256` and the committed build from #37911 are untouched, and a build that stores `amount_paid` as a plain number is still sent the card's value.

## Tests

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` gains a `[#35654]` block against the real card and the committed build (`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json`), with a double that runs the build shape the card names: `amount_paid` a roll-up of payments, a payment capped at the invoice's open balance, a roll-up value sent stored as written.

- the committed build's invoice roll-up is `amount_paid` (and `derivedFields` also lists the autonumber `name`, which stays sent); the card states each invoice's `amount_paid` as the sum of its payments;
- with the build's roll-ups, all 72 payments load, `seed.leftOut` is `demoorder_invoice.amount_paid` and `demoorder_sales_order.total_amount`, every invoice ends at the card's `amount_paid`, and `INV-1058` keeps its name;
- control: sent the end state, the cap refuses 66 payments, all on `demoorder_payment`, with the rule's message;
- `restoreSeededRows` re-inserts a removed invoice without its roll-up value.

Ablation: with the `src/` change stashed, the three new behaviour tests fail and the control passes.

<details><summary>runs</summary>

- `npx vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` (in `packages/qa/scenarios`): 180 passed.
- Whole package: 1384 passed, 14 skipped, 1 failed: `test/runner/packages.test.ts` "every install ran the workspace's pinned pnpm" — fails identically on `main` f926dfab in this container (the stash run), so not this change. `test/build/*` passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` in `packages/qa/scenarios`: clean.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 64 derived, 62 exit 0, 2 exit 3 NOT MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` did not reach its verdict here; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package built). Left to CI.

</details>

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd packages/qa/scenarios && npx vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 35654` prints 4 passed.
